scope: Read-only static architecture and security baseline. Findings are candidate issues, not final severity decisions.
commands: rg -n patterns for model_preferences, LIMIT 1, DDL, provider endpoints, Neo4j, credential encryption and authority guards
PowerShell route inventory of frontend/app/api/**/route.ts and intelligence/api/*.py

evidence.inventory: 61 Next route files; only connectors, graph root, graph chat, gdpr-agent/analyze-policy and retention import/call requireApiSession.
evidence.detail: Protected-state handlers do not import or invoke requireApiSession. Auth endpoints are expected exemptions; every other route needs an explicit route-inventory exemption or a guard.

findings.candidate_invariant: Fail static CI if a frontend API route outside a narrow documented public/auth allowlist neither imports nor awaits requireApiSession; require the authority's profileId in personal-data queries and internal forwards.

evidence.detail: main.py includes all routers. Evidence exposes graph mutation endpoints; execution exposes engine invocation; insights accepts arbitrary subject_id, all without require_internal_request.

findings.candidate_invariant: Every Python router except explicitly documented health/readiness must declare dependencies=[Depends(require_internal_request)]; profile-bearing endpoints must derive/validate profile scope from the trusted internal header rather than a user-controlled query/body field.

evidence.detail: These proxies forward JSON/query parameters to the intelligence service with content-type only; they neither authenticate the browser request nor send intelligenceAuthorityHeaders.

findings.candidate_invariant: All frontend calls to the intelligence service must await requireApiSession and include intelligenceAuthorityHeaders(authority.profileId); reject direct localhost/intelligence forwarding without both.

evidence.detail: getModelPreferences reads model_preferences WHERE id=1 and applies Google defaults to extraction, graph and policy. The legacy route remains active.

findings.candidate_invariant: No runtime source outside a migration/compatibility quarantine may contain a SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE against model_preferences. Task execution must resolve only through the canonical Task Router.

evidence.detail: discover-dpo directly selects Google credentials and creates GoogleGenAI. Discovery/model listing endpoints also call providers directly. Python Gemini clients are not visibly mediated by frontend Task Router/execution record creation.

findings.candidate_invariant: Provider-generation SDK imports and provider completion endpoints may occur only in approved Task Router adapters; each invocation path must have an execution record assertion. Discovery-only endpoints need a separately approved allowlist.

evidence.canonical_writer: intelligence/graph/projection.py declares GraphProjectionService as sole writer.
runtime_ddl: intelligence/graph/projection.py:29-30 ensure_schema executes CREATE CONSTRAINT and CREATE INDEX during projection.
evidence.mutation_entrypoint: intelligence/api/evidence.py has manual-node, manual-retire, manual-merge, backfill-graph and onsit-bulk endpoints without router authority.

findings.candidate_invariant: Cypher DDL belongs only in an explicit migration/bootstrap mechanism. Mutating Cypher must be confined to GraphProjectionService and only reachable through authenticated, profile-scoped evidence commands.

evidence.detail: Settings and insight routes explicitly select the first profile rather than the authenticated canonical profile.

findings.candidate_invariant: Forbid SELECT from user_profiles/profiles with LIMIT 1 in runtime sources except a documented setup-only migration path. Profile-scoped data access must predicate by authority.profileId.

evidence.detail: Candidate personal-data routes issue database queries or accept IDs/subject_id but have no session authority in the route. Static review cannot prove all underlying table joins, so this is a mandatory dynamic/API-scope test target.

findings.candidate_invariant: Authenticated integration tests must create two profiles and prove reads, writes, deletes and forwarded subject identifiers cannot cross profile boundaries. Static route guard inventory provides the first gate.

evidence.detail: The rendered status text is literal 'System Online'; no health-state data flow is adjacent to it.

findings.candidate_invariant: Forbid literal operational-health labels in UI status surfaces; component/browser tests must inject a failed dependency and assert non-green aggregate health.

stores: frontend/lib/credentials.ts: reversible XOR/base64 obfuscation, documented as Neo4j ONSIT credentials
evidence.detail: Credentials are split across ai_credentials, app_settings and Neo4j-oriented helper terminology, with incompatible formats. CBC has no authentication; XOR is not encryption.

findings.candidate_invariant: Ban createCipheriv aes-256-cbc and custom XOR obfuscation in runtime source. Permit secret persistence only through one AES-GCM helper/versioned ciphertext and one canonical store; require round-trip and tamper-rejection tests.

limitations: This is source evidence only; it does not establish authenticated runtime behaviour, actual database contents, deployed network exposure, or exploitability.
The route inventory intentionally treats auth/setup routes as possible exemptions; the lead agent must establish and document the exact public allowlist.
Existing user changes were present before this scan and were not modified.
